math/01_gcd_lcm_euclid.algorithm:
gcd(a, b):
    a = |a|, b = |b|
    while b != 0:   (stop only when the remainder is exactly 0)
        remainder = a % b
        a = b
        b = remainder
    return a
lcm(a, b):
    if a == 0 or b == 0: return 0
    return |a| // gcd(a, b) * |b|

math/02_primes_sieve_and_primality.algorithm:
is_prime(n):
    if n < 2: return false
    d = 2
    while d * d <= n:   (<= not <: a perfect square's only small factor is sqrt(n))
        if n % d == 0: return false
        d = d + 1
    return true
sieve(n):
    if n < 2: return []
    is_p = [true] * (n + 1), is_p[0] = is_p[1] = false
    for p = 2 while p * p <= n:
        if is_p[p]:
            for multiple = p * p, p * p + p, ... up to n: is_p[multiple] = false
    return every i in 2..n with is_p[i] true

math/03_fast_power_and_modular_arithmeti.algorithm:
power(base, exp):
    result = 1   (the empty product, not base)
    while exp > 0:
        if lowest bit of exp is 1: result = result * base
        base = base * base
        exp = exp >> 1
    return result
mod_power(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1, base = base % mod
    while exp > 0:
        if lowest bit of exp is 1: result = result * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        exp = exp >> 1
    return result % mod

math/04_digits_reverse_integer_and_palin.algorithm:
reverse_integer(x):
    sign = -1 if x < 0 else 1, n = |x|, rev = 0
    while n > 0:
        digit = n % 10, n = n // 10
        rev = rev * 10 + digit
    rev = rev * sign
    if rev outside [-2^31, 2^31 - 1]: return 0
    return rev
is_palindrome_number(x):
    if x < 0: return false
    if x ends in 0 and x != 0: return false
    half = 0
    while x > half:   (stop once the reversed part is at least as long as the rest)
        digit = x % 10, x = x // 10
        half = half * 10 + digit
    return x == half or x == half // 10

math/05_base_conversion_and_excel_column.algorithm:
to_base(n, base):
    if n == 0: return "0"
    sign = "-" if n < 0 else "", n = |n|, digits = []
    while n > 0:
        digit = n % base, n = n // base, append DIGITS[digit]
    reverse digits, return sign + digits joined
from_base(s, base):
    n = 0
    for each character ch: n = n * base + value of ch
    return n
column_title(n):
    letters = []
    while n > 0:
        n = n - 1   (digits are 1..26: 26 must give remainder 25 = Z and quotient 0)
        append letter 'A' + n % 26, n = n // 26
    reverse letters, return them joined
column_number(s):
    n = 0
    for each letter ch: n = n * 26 + (ch - 'A' + 1)
    return n

math/06_random_pick_and_reservoir_sampli.algorithm:
reservoir_sample(stream, k, rng):
    reservoir = [], i = 0
    for each item in stream:
        if i < k: append item to reservoir
        else:
            j = random integer in 0..i   (item i is the (i + 1)-th seen: chance k / (i + 1))
            if j < k: reservoir[j] = item
        i = i + 1
    return reservoir
random_pick_index(nums, target, rng):
    pick = -1, seen = 0
    for each index i:
        if nums[i] == target:
            seen = seen + 1
            if random integer in 0..seen-1 == 0: pick = i
    return pick

matrices/05_game_of_life_in_place.algorithm:
count_live_neighbors(board, row, col):
    live = 0
    for each of the 8 offsets (dr, dc), skipping (0, 0):
        if (row + dr, col + dc) is inside the board:
            live = live + (board[row + dr][col + dc] & 1)   (bit 0 only: bit 1 may hold a next state)
    return live
game_of_life(board):
    for each cell (row, col):
        live = count_live_neighbors(board, row, col)
        alive = board[row][col] & 1
        if live == 3 or (live == 2 and alive): set bit 1 of board[row][col]
    for each cell: board[row][col] = board[row][col] >> 1
    return board

matrices/06_matrix_traversal_patterns.algorithm:
row_major(matrix):
    for each row, for each value in the row: append value
col_major(matrix):
    for each col, for each row: append matrix[row][col]
neighbors(matrix, row, col, dirs):
    for each (dr, dc) in dirs:
        nr = row + dr, nc = col + dc
        if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols: append (nr, nc)
    return the list
anti_diagonals(matrix):
    for d from 0 to rows + cols - 2:   (m + n - 1 diagonals, cells with row + col == d)
        first_row = max(0, d - cols + 1), last_row = min(rows - 1, d)
        for row from first_row to last_row inclusive: append matrix[row][d - row]
    return the list

strings/02_two_pointer_palindromes_and_r.algorithm:
is_palindrome(s):
    lo = 0, hi = last index
    while lo < hi:
        if s[lo] is not alphanumeric: lo = lo + 1
        else if s[hi] is not alphanumeric: hi = hi - 1
        else:
            if lowercase s[lo] != lowercase s[hi]: return false
            lo = lo + 1, hi = hi - 1
    return true
reverse_range(chars, lo, hi):
    while lo < hi: swap chars[lo] and chars[hi], lo = lo + 1, hi = hi - 1
reverse_words(s):
    chars = list of s, reverse_range over the whole list
    start = 0
    for i from 0 to len(chars) inclusive:   (i == len closes the last word)
        if i == len(chars) or chars[i] is a space:
            reverse_range(chars, start, i - 1)
            start = i + 1
    return chars joined

strings/03_kmp_prefix_function.algorithm:
build_failure(pattern):
    fail = [0] * m, k = 0
    for i from 1 to m - 1:   (fail[0] is always 0: a border is a PROPER prefix)
        while k > 0 and pattern[i] != pattern[k]: k = fail[k - 1]
        if pattern[i] == pattern[k]: k = k + 1
        fail[i] = k
    return fail
kmp_search(text, pattern):
    fail = build_failure(pattern), hits = [], j = 0
    for each index i of text:
        while j > 0 and text[i] != pattern[j]: j = fail[j - 1]   (while, not if)
        if text[i] == pattern[j]: j = j + 1
        if j == m:
            append i - j + 1 to hits
            j = fail[m - 1]
    return hits

strings/04_rabin_karp_rolling_hash.algorithm:
poly_hash(s):
    h = 0
    for each character ch: h = (h * BASE + ch) % MOD
    return h
rabin_karp(text, pattern):
    if m > n: return []
    high = BASE^(m - 1) % MOD   (weight of the window's leftmost character)
    target = poly_hash(pattern), h = poly_hash(first m characters of text)
    hits = []
    for i from 0 to n - m:
        if h == target and text[i..i + m) == pattern: append i
        if i + m < n:
            h = (h - text[i] * high) * BASE + text[i + m]
            h = h % MOD
    return hits

strings/05_encode_decode_strings_and_joi.algorithm:
encode(strs):
    parts = []
    for each string s: append str(len(s)) + "#" + s
    return parts joined once   (one join copies each char once; += in a loop is quadratic)
decode(s):
    out = [], i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        j = index of the first '#' at or after i
        length = int(s[i..j))
        start = j + 1
        append s[start..start + length)
        i = start + length
    return out
